answer: Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The design leans on escrowed payment for graded work, published publicly on failure, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. Each submission hangs on the garden of a task receipt, and the horizon is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. By the anchor of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up.
